answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 48936 Country: India Title: Regarding qiblah direction while offering namaz Question: I am working in a company and it has provided us with a room for offering namaz. After some days we came to know that the direction in which we were offering namaz was a bit tilted (about maximum 6-7 degrees). It has become very difficult to make rows if we make proper saf. So please guide us. How much can be deviated in such conditions? Answer ID: 48936 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1845/511/H=12/1434) There is no issue if you performed salah with the difference of 6-7 degrees, neither it is necessary to repeat the salah. You should see the direction of the old mosques in your area and then arrange the rows in the room accordingly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
